metadata.name: solpredict
metadata.description: SOLPredict — Decentralized Prediction Market on Solana

instructions.name: add_liquidity
docs: Add liquidity to a market and receive YES/NO tokens + LP position.

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is halted.

instructions.name: approve_market
docs: Approve a pending market proposal and create the market (admin-only).

instructions.name: batch_settle
docs: Batch-settle multiple markets in one transaction (admin-only).

instructions.name: buy_shares
docs: Buy YES or NO shares on a market.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Buyer — signs and pays SOL.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market PDA — must be Open and not expired.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury PDA — receives SOL payment.

accounts.name: yes_mint
docs: YES token mint — may or may not be the one we mint to (depends on side).

accounts.name: no_mint
docs: NO token mint.

accounts.name: buyer_yes_ata
docs: Buyer's ATA for the chosen mint — init_if_needed since this may be
the buyer's first purchase of this token.

accounts.name: buyer_no_ata
docs: Buyer's ATA for NO mint.

accounts.name: user_position
docs: UserPosition PDA — init_if_needed for first-time buyers.
Seeds: ["position", market, buyer]

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is
halted. Absent when the program has never been paused.

instructions.name: cancel_market
docs: Cancel an open market (admin-only).

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Cancel an open limit order and reclaim escrowed SOL or tokens.

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is halted.

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: Claim a full refund on a cancelled market.

accounts.name: claimer
docs: User claiming refund.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market — must be Cancelled.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury PDA — refunds SOL to user.

accounts.name: yes_mint
docs: YES mint.

accounts.name: no_mint
docs: NO mint.

accounts.name: claimer_yes_ata
docs: User's YES token ATA.

accounts.name: claimer_no_ata
docs: User's NO token ATA.

accounts.name: user_position
docs: UserPosition PDA — double-refund guard and rent recovery.

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Claim pro-rata SOL rewards on a settled market (winners only).

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Close UserPosition PDA after market resolution and reclaim ~0.0015 SOL rent deposit.

accounts.name: user
docs: Position owner reclaiming rent.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market — must NOT be Open (trading must be ended/settled/cancelled).

accounts.name: user_position
docs: UserPosition PDA — closed and rent sent back to user.

instructions.name: emergency_pause
docs: Emergency-pause the entire program to halt trading (admin-only).

instructions.name: emergency_unpause
docs: Unpause the program (requires guardian confirmations).

instructions.name: emergency_withdraw
docs: Emergency withdrawal of funds from a settled or paused market (admin-only).

instructions.name: fill_order
docs: Match/fill an open limit order (P2P trade).

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is halted.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time program bootstrap. Sets admin and fee percentage.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The caller who will become the program admin.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config PDA — singleton, created once.
Seeds: ["config"]

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Create a new prediction market (admin-only).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Admin signer — must match `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config PDA — read admin + increment market_count.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market PDA — created for this market.
Seeds: ["market", market_id.to_le_bytes()]
market_id = config.market_count (before increment)

accounts.name: yes_mint
docs: YES token mint — mint authority = Market PDA (trustless minting).
Seeds: ["yes_mint", market.key()]

accounts.name: no_mint
docs: NO token mint — mint authority = Market PDA (trustless minting).
Seeds: ["no_mint", market.key()]

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury PDA — holds market's SOL pool.
Seeds: ["treasury", market.key()]
SystemAccount: no data, just holds lamports.

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Place an on-chain limit order (Bid or Ask) for a prediction outcome.

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is halted.

instructions.name: propose_market
docs: Propose a new prediction market (anyone can propose).

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Remove liquidity and burn LP tokens, receiving SOL back.

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is halted.

instructions.name: sell_shares
docs: Sell YES or NO shares back to the pool before market expiry.

accounts.name: emergency_pause
docs: Optional emergency-pause account. When present and paused, trading is halted.

instructions.name: settle_market
docs: Settle a market using a Pyth oracle price (admin-only).

accounts.name: price_update
docs: the account data, verifies feed ID, staleness, and confidence.

instructions.name: settle_market_manual
docs: Settle a market manually (admin-only).

instructions.name: update_admin
docs: Transfer platform admin authority to a new wallet (admin-only).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Current admin signer — must match `config.admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config PDA — its `admin` field is overwritten.

instructions.name: update_market
docs: Update market parameters (admin-only).

instructions.name: withdraw_fees
docs: Withdraw collected protocol fees from a settled market (admin-only).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the program admin can perform this action

errors.name: MarketNotOpen
errors.msg: Market is not open for trading

errors.name: TooEarlyToSettle
errors.msg: Market cannot be settled before resolve_ts

errors.name: MarketNotSettled
errors.msg: Market has not been settled yet

errors.name: MarketNotCancelled
errors.msg: Market is not in cancelled state

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Rewards already claimed for this position

errors.name: InvalidOracleFeed
errors.msg: Oracle feed does not match market's configured feed

errors.name: LowOracleConfidence
errors.msg: Oracle price confidence interval too wide

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Provided mint does not match market's configured mint

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity must be greater than zero and within limits

errors.name: InvalidEndTime
errors.msg: End time must be in the future

errors.name: SharePriceTooLow
errors.msg: Share price is below the minimum allowed

errors.name: FeeAlreadyWithdrawn
errors.msg: Protocol fee has already been withdrawn

errors.name: UseOracleSettlement
errors.msg: Price-backed markets must use settle_market with oracle price feed

errors.name: UseManualSettlement
errors.msg: Markets without a price feed must use settle_market_manual

errors.name: NotAWinner
errors.msg: User did not win this market

errors.name: CryptoMustUseOracle
errors.msg: Crypto markets must use oracle settlement

errors.name: InvalidPriceBps
errors.msg: Limit price basis points must be between 1 and 9999

errors.name: SelfTradingNotAllowed
errors.msg: Cannot match trade against your own order

errors.name: EndTimeTooSoon
errors.msg: Market end time must be at least 1 hour in the future

errors.name: EndTimeTooFar
errors.msg: Market end time too far (max 1 year)

errors.name: ResolveTooSoon
errors.msg: Resolution time must be >= end time

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: Pyth price is stale (older than 60 seconds)

errors.name: UsePythForCrypto
errors.msg: Use Pyth oracle to settle Crypto markets

errors.name: EmergencyPaused
errors.msg: Trading is halted — the market is under an emergency pause

errors.name: ProposalNotPending
errors.msg: Proposal is not in Pending state

errors.name: ProposalBondTooLow
errors.msg: Proposal bond is below the minimum required

types.name: Category
docs: Market category for frontend filtering.

types.name: Comparison
docs: Price comparison direction for settlement.

types.name: Config
docs: Config PDA — singleton account storing program-wide configuration.
Seeds: ["config"]
Created once by `initialize_config`. Anchor's `init` constraint
naturally rejects a second call (account already exists).

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin pubkey — only this key can create/settle/cancel markets
and withdraw fees.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in basis points (e.g. 200 = 2%), validated ≤ 1000 (10%).
Taken from the losing pool only at settlement time.

fields.name: market_count
docs: Auto-incrementing market counter, used as each market's unique id.
Also used as part of the Market PDA seed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA canonical bump, stored on-chain for efficient re-derivation.

types.name: EmergencyPause
docs: Emergency pause state — singleton account.
When paused, all non-admin trading is halted.

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether the program is paused

fields.name: paused_by
docs: Admin who paused (for audit trail)

fields.name: paused_at
docs: Timestamp of pause

fields.name: guardians
docs: Multisig addresses that can unpause

fields.name: required_confirmations
docs: Number of guardian confirmations required to unpause

fields.name: confirmations
docs: Current guardian confirmations count

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

types.name: EmergencyPauseChanged
docs: Emitted when program is paused or unpaused.

types.name: EmergencyWithdraw
docs: Emitted when admin performs emergency withdrawal.

types.name: FeesWithdrawn
docs: Emitted when the admin withdraws collected fees.

types.name: LiquidityAdded
docs: Emitted when liquidity is added via `add_liquidity`.

types.name: LiquidityPosition
docs: Liquidity Provider position for a single market.
Tracks how much liquidity an LP has deposited.

fields.name: owner
docs: LP wallet address

fields.name: market
docs: Market this LP position belongs to

fields.name: lp_tokens
docs: Amount of LP tokens minted (representing share of the pool)

fields.name: yes_deposited
docs: Total YES tokens deposited

fields.name: no_deposited
docs: Total NO tokens deposited

fields.name: total_lamports_deposited
docs: Total lamports deposited as liquidity

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when position was created

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Unix timestamp of last liquidity modification

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

types.name: LiquidityRemoved
docs: Emitted when liquidity is removed via `remove_liquidity`.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Unique market identifier (auto-incremented from Config.market_count).

fields.name: authority
docs: Market creator (== config.admin for MVP).

fields.name: question
docs: The prediction question (e.g. "Will SOL close above $250...?").
Max 200 characters.

fields.name: description
docs: Settlement rules / description text. Max 400 characters.

fields.name: category
docs: Market category for frontend filtering.

fields.name: oracle_feed_id
docs: Pyth oracle feed id for the asset this market tracks.
Verified at settlement time against the passed-in price account.

fields.name: target_price
docs: Target price for settlement comparison (in Pyth's fixed-point format).

fields.name: target_expo
docs: Target price exponent (matches Pyth's exponent representation).

fields.name: comparison
docs: How to compare oracle price vs target: GreaterThan or LessThan.

fields.name: end_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when trading stops (no more buys accepted after this).

fields.name: resolve_ts
docs: Earliest unix timestamp when settlement is allowed (>= end_ts).

fields.name: status
docs: Current lifecycle status: Open, Settled, or Cancelled.

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: Winner after settlement: Unset, Yes, or No.

fields.name: yes_mint
docs: Pubkey of the YES SPL token mint (PDA-derived).

fields.name: no_mint
docs: Pubkey of the NO SPL token mint (PDA-derived).

fields.name: yes_pool_lamports
docs: Total lamports deposited by YES-side buyers.

fields.name: no_pool_lamports
docs: Total lamports deposited by NO-side buyers.

fields.name: yes_supply
docs: Total YES tokens minted (in base units, i.e. shares * 10^6).

fields.name: no_supply
docs: Total NO tokens minted (in base units).

fields.name: total_payout_pool
docs: Computed at settlement: total_pool - fee. This is the pot winners split.

fields.name: fee_collected
docs: Fee collected at settlement (from losing pool only).

fields.name: fee_withdrawn
docs: Double-withdraw guard for admin fee withdrawal.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Total lamports already claimed by winners (prevents treasury over-drain).

fields.name: settled_price
docs: Oracle price used for settlement (stored for transparency/auditability).

fields.name: settled_expo
docs: Oracle exponent at settlement time.

fields.name: settled_at
docs: Timestamp of settlement.

fields.name: share_price_lamports
docs: Fixed price per share in lamports (set at market creation).

fields.name: bump
docs: Market PDA canonical bump.

fields.name: treasury_bump
docs: Treasury PDA canonical bump (stored here for efficient claim/refund CPIs).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee in basis points (e.g. 30 = 0.3%). Charged from the losing pool at settlement.

fields.name: reentrancy_lock
docs: Reentrancy protection lock.

types.name: MarketCancelled
docs: Emitted when a market is cancelled via `cancel_market`.

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: Emitted when a new market is created via `initialize_market`.
Frontend subscribes for live "new market" toasts and grid updates.

types.name: MarketProposalProcessed
docs: Emitted when a market proposal is approved (or rejected) by the admin.

types.name: MarketProposed
docs: Emitted when a user proposes a new market.

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: Emitted when a market is settled via `settle_market` (Pyth oracle).

types.name: MarketSettledManual
docs: Emitted when a market is settled manually (non-crypto markets).

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Market lifecycle status.

types.name: MarketUpdated
docs: Emitted when market details are updated via `update_market`.

types.name: Order
docs: Order PDA — represents an on-chain limit order (Bid or Ask) for a market.
Seeds: ["order", market.key(), maker.key(), order_id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: market
docs: Market account this order belongs to.

fields.name: maker
docs: Order maker address.

fields.name: order_id
docs: Unique order ID per user.

fields.name: side
docs: Outcome side: YES or NO.

fields.name: is_buy
docs: Order side: true = Buy (Bid), false = Sell (Ask).

fields.name: price_bps
docs: Limit price in basis points (1 to 9999 representing 0.0001 to 0.9999 SOL per share).

fields.name: quantity
docs: Total quantity of shares in base units (shares * 10^6).

fields.name: filled_quantity
docs: Quantity already filled.

fields.name: status
docs: Current order status.

fields.name: bump
docs: Order PDA canonical bump.

types.name: PositionClosed
docs: Emitted when a user closes their position account to reclaim rent.

types.name: ReentrancyLock
docs: Reentrancy guard stored in accounts.
Use explicit acquire/release within a scope block to avoid
Rust borrow checker conflicts with mutable account access.

types.name: RefundClaimed
docs: Emitted when a user claims a refund on a cancelled market.

types.name: RewardsClaimed
docs: Emitted when a winner claims their rewards via `claim_rewards`.

types.name: SharesPurchased
docs: Emitted when shares are purchased via `buy_shares`.
Powers the live activity feed and real-time probability bar updates.

types.name: SharesSold
docs: Emitted when a user sells shares back to the pool before expiry.

types.name: Side
docs: Side for buy_shares instruction — YES or NO.

types.name: UserPosition
docs: UserPosition PDA — one per user per market.
Seeds: ["position", market_pubkey, user_pubkey]
Token balances in the user's ATAs are the source of truth for claim
amounts; this PDA is a portfolio-page index AND the double-claim guard.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of this position.

fields.name: market
docs: Market this position belongs to.

fields.name: yes_amount
docs: Number of YES shares purchased (in base units, i.e. shares * 10^6).

fields.name: no_amount
docs: Number of NO shares purchased (in base units).

fields.name: claimed
docs: Whether rewards/refund have been claimed. Double-claim guard.

fields.name: total_spent_lamports
docs: Total lamports spent across all purchases in this market.
Used for portfolio P&L display on the frontend.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA canonical bump.

types.name: WinningOutcome
docs: Winning outcome after settlement.
